thread:
mia_cs: Heads-up: BlueCurve renewal call next Tue. They flagged SLO alignment + potential credits. Need a one-pager with uptime + p99 latency, plus draft credit calc. Can folks assemble data by EOD Fri? @tomas_support @raj_customer_success @olivia_revenue_ops
raj_customer_success: Got it. Current contract: 99.9% monthly uptime, p99 latency 750ms. Their prod cluster had a few incidents last month. I'll pull the SLA window numbers.
ellie_account_manager: Calling out: customer is sensitive to credits. If we can show mitigating fixes and compensation options (discount + extended support), they'd prefer that over a cash credit. Also want playbook for communication.
tomas_support: I can collect incidents and metrics. Query I'm using for error budget burn (PromQL):

sum(rate(requests_total{job='inference',customer='bluecurve',status!~"2.."}[30d])) / sum(rate(requests_total{job='inference',customer='bluecurve'}[30d]))

Also p99 latency: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{customer='bluecurve'}[30d])) by (le))

Will attach dashboard links.
olivia_revenue_ops: What billing window do we use for credit calc? Contract says monthly, billing cycle ends on the 25th. Confirming we apply prorated credits only if uptime < 99.9%.
incident-bot: incident-bot: Created incident INC-2023-842 for GPU node instability on 2024-11-09 03:14 UTC. Severity: P2. Mitigated 2024-11-09 06:02 UTC.
raj_customer_success: I ran a quick check: uptime for Oct (25th Sep-24th Oct) 99.87% -> below threshold by 0.03%. If we follow SLA table, that triggers 5% service credit. Need final verification from infra logs.
mia_cs: Ok that number could translate to $X credit. @olivia_revenue_ops can you run the formal calc and draft the statement? I'll draft the one-pager focusing on root causes, mitigations, and optional credit.
ellie_account_manager: :thumbsup: I'll prep customer-facing language that emphasizes remediation + optional credit. Also want to propose a short RTO for their onboarding issues.
tomas_support: Uploading incident list + timelines to the shared folder: drive.redwood/bluecurve/slo-evidence. Also attaching raw logs and node restart times.
olivia_revenue_ops: Draft calc: prorated credit = max(0, (SLA_target - measured_uptime) / SLA_target) * monthly_fee. Using their fee $35,000 -> gives ~$1050. Will put exact formula in the one-pager.
mia_cs: Perfect. Quick ask: can someone sanity-check the PromQL and numbers before I send the draft? Need signoff by Mon morning. Thanks!
